title: Accounts Assistant - Hybrid
description:
Exciting opportunity in Ross-on-Wye for an Accounts Assistant to join an active and busy accounts function in a nationally recognised company in a full time role.

You will support the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable function, assisting with supplier payments, bank reconciliations, credit control, customer and supplier queries, and maintaining accurate financial records. Full training on company process and systems provided.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices accurately and within deadlines.
- Support supplier payment runs and maintain supplier accounts.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve invoice or payment queries.
- Process daily banking transactions and complete bank reconciliations.
- Assist with month-end journals and financial reconciliations.
- Support credit control by monitoring aged debt and chasing overdue payments.
- Respond to customer and supplier queries in a professional manner.
- Maintain accurate financial records, documentation and account data.
- Work with colleagues to identify and support process improvements.

Key Attributes
- Previous finance or accounts experience essential
- Reliable, team player
- Confident communicator

Hours: Full time: Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5pm (1hr lunch) - 37.5h pw with option to work from home up to 1-2 days per week once fully trained and settled.

Salary: £12.92 - £14.36 per hour + benefits including:
- Hybrid working
- Free parking
- EAP Programme.
- 25 days holiday PLUS bank holidays + annual leave purchase scheme (pro rata for temp)
- Birthday day off.

title: Temporary Accounts Assistant
description:
Temporary Accounts Assistant Ross-on-Wye Salary: Competitive, depending on experience Temporary, approximately 2-3 months Department: Finance

The Role

Working closely with the Accounts Supervisor and wider Finance Team, you will provide support across the sales and purchase ledger functions, helping to ensure financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.

You will gain practical experience using finance systems, processing invoices, reconciling accounts and communicating with internal colleagues, customers and suppliers.

The successful candidate will be organised, proactive and comfortable working to deadlines, with the ability to adapt quickly and support the team where needed.

Key Responsibilities
- Raise and process project details, contract sales orders, applications for payment and sales invoices.
- Process purchase orders and purchase invoices, checking accuracy against relevant purchase orders.
- Raise sundry sales invoices and credit notes.
- Set up new customer and supplier accounts within the finance system.
- Assist with bank reconciliations and the processing of credit card expenses.
- Prepare and issue customer statements as required.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies.
- Respond promptly and professionally to emails and requests from customers, suppliers and colleagues.
- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transactions are processed in a timely manner.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and working practices.
- Provide general administrative support to the Finance Team and assist with ad hoc duties as required.

About You

We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, good numerical skills and a genuine interest in finance.

You will ideally have:
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good numerical ability and confidence working with figures.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Good IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Excel and Teams.
- Clear and professional communication skills.
- A flexible approach and the ability to adapt within a fast-paced environment.
- The confidence to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
- A willingness to learn new systems and processes.

Previous experience in a finance department or office environment would be advantageous, as would an understanding of sales and purchase ledgers. However, candidates with transferable administrative skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

What's on Offer?
- A temporary assignment of approximately 3-6 months.
- An opportunity to gain valuable hands-on finance experience.
- Exposure to sales ledger, purchase ledger and general finance processes.
- The chance to develop practical skills within an established Finance Team.
- A varied role offering insight into the day-to-day operations of a finance function.

For further information, please contact Rhian Mountjoy

By responding, we will register you as a candidate with Seymour John Limited. To understand how we will use your personal data, please read the Privacy Policy on our website.
